summary.text: Will Penterman is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 38 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Terri Wenkman.
He served in the U.S. Army and continues to serve in the U.S. Army Reserve.

paragraphs.text: William Penterman earned a bachelor's degree from Ripon College in 2018.
His career experience includes working as a legislative assistant and a committee clerk with the Wisconsin State Assembly.
Penterman won the July 13, 2021 special general election for Assembly District 37, defeating Pete Adams and Stephen Ratzlaff Jr., and won re-election there in 2022.
He won the 2024 general election for District 38, defeating Izzy Hassey Nevarez.
For 2025-2026 he chairs the Veterans and Military Affairs Committee and is vice-chair of the Children and Families Committee.
